defs.def: to move your head or the top half of your body forwards and downwards as a sign of respect or to say hello or goodbye 鞠躬；点头

ex.s: Worry, fear, self-distrust bows the heart and turns the spirit back to dust.
ex.t: 忧虑、恐惧、自我怀疑会使心灵屈服，让精神归于尘土。

ex.s: In 405, he quit the service of the court for good, expressing his unhappiness in the now famous line that he would not “bow like a servant in return for five dou of grain”.
ex.t: 405年，他永远辞去了官职，用如今那句名言表达了自己的不快——他不愿“为五斗米折腰”。

ex.s: Elsewhere, people favour shaking hands, bowing from the waist, or nodding the head when they meet someone else.
ex.t: 在其他地方，人们见面时喜欢握手、鞠躬或点头。

ex.s: The moon, like a flower, In heaven’s high bower, With silent delight, Sits and smiles on the night.
ex.t: 月亮，像一朵花，在天国高处的凉亭里，带着无声的欢喜，静坐微笑望着夜色。

defs.def: to move your head forwards and downwards 低头；垂首
to bend or make sth bend （使）弯曲
the act of bending your head or the upper part of your body forward in order to say hello or goodbye to sb or to show respect 鞠躬；弯腰行礼
the front part of a boat or ship 船头；艏

ex.s: Walden When I first paddled a boat on Walden, it was completely surrounded by thick and lofty pine and oak woods, and in some of its coves grape-vines had run over the trees next the water and formed bowers under which a boat could pass.
ex.t: 《瓦尔登湖》　我第一次在瓦尔登湖划船时，湖完全被高大茂密的松橡林环绕，在一些小湾里，葡萄藤爬上了水边的树木，形成可供小舟穿过的凉亭。

defs.def: a weapon used for shooting arrows, consisting of a long curved piece of wood with a tight string joining its ends 弓
a knot with two loops and two loose ends which is used for decoration on clothes, in hair, etc. or for tying shoes 蝴蝶结
a long thin piece of wood with thin string stretched along it, used for playing musical instruments such as the violin 琴弓
